name: Watershed Segmentation and Object Separation
description:
Perform watershed segmentation on the 'Blobs' sample image to separate touching objects.

1. Open the 'Blobs (25K)' sample image (File > Open Samples > Blobs).
2. Apply a threshold to create a binary mask (Image > Adjust > Threshold).
3. Count the objects in this binary state *before* separation (Analyze > Analyze Particles) and note the count.
4. Apply the Watershed algorithm to separate touching objects (Process > Binary > Watershed).
5. Count and measure the objects *after* separation.
6. Save the individual measurements of the separated objects to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/watershed_measurements.csv'.
7. Create a summary text file at '~/ImageJ_Data/results/watershed_summary.txt' that explicitly states:
   - The object count BEFORE watershed
   - The object count AFTER watershed
   - The difference (number of new objects resolved)

The 'After' count must be higher than the 'Before' count to demonstrate successful separation.
